name: Yongri de Ningshi - The Gaze of The Eternal Sun
original_name: 永日的凝视 - The Gaze of The Eternal Sun
source:
The female protagonist, Shikonomiya Sakuya, is troubled by her own peculiarities - she is able to retain her memories after death and continue to be reincarnated as a human being.

As she goes through the cycle of death and resurrection, her ability to regenerate herself grows stronger, causing it to become increasingly difficult for her to die.

Having experienced several instances where everyone around her died and often had to spend the rest of her life alone, Sakura has a twin sister in this life: Shikonomiya Hoshi.

Although she is a bit disappointed after confirming that the other person is not the same existence as herself, Hoshi's favouritism towards her as a younger sister still warms Sakura's heart.

Worried that her sister, Hoshi Shikinomiya, will find out that she is an ‘inhuman being’, an unknown angel, Crocell, comes to her home and promises to help her find out the truth about her constant reincarnation.

The three of them meet by fate, and their story is about to begin.

As the story progresses, the mystery of the player's immortality is gradually solved. In the process, players can establish romantic relationships with different characters through their own choices. At the same time, different choices can also understand the truth of the protagonist's immortality from different perspectives ......

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2941540]Steam[/url]]
translation:
女主角四宫咲夜因自己的特殊性而困扰——她死后仍能保留记忆，并继续转世为人类。

随着死亡与复活的轮回，她的重生能力越来越强，让她变得越来越难死。

经历了数次身边的人都死去，常常不得不独自度过余生的小樱，今生有一个孪生妹妹：四宫星。

虽然确认对方与自己不是同一存在后有些失望，但星对她这个妹妹的偏爱，还是让小樱心里暖暖的。

由于担心妹妹志色宫发现自己是“非人”，不知名的天使克罗塞尔来到她家，承诺帮助她查明自己不断转世的真相。

三人因缘际会相遇，他们的故事即将开始。

随着故事的进展，玩家的不死之谜也逐渐解开。在此过程中，玩家可以通过自己的选择与不同的角色建立恋爱关系。同时，不同的选择也能从不同的角度了解主角不死的真相……

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2941540]Steam[/url]]
